$comment: Store listing fields that apify push never sends. Applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs after every deploy. Title, description and categories live in actor.json. The SEO text below is the live text as of 2026-09-12; holehe is the top earner, so change it deliberately, not as a side effect.
seoTitle: Email OSINT Tool - Find Registered Accounts on 120+ Sites
seoDescription: Reverse email lookup tool. Discover which platforms (Instagram, GitHub, Discord, Amazon, Spotify, 115+ more) an email is registered on. No alerts sent. OSINT & security research.
actorPermissionLevel$comment: Was FULL_PERMISSIONS, which set isWhiteListedForAgenticPayments=false and lowers the quality score. main.py uses only the default dataset, Actor.charge and the status message, all allowed under limited permissions. No rebuild needed for this switch.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Measured 2026-09-11 on the same 8 emails: 4 GB 32.5 s / 0.0362 CU, 2 GB 34.7 s / 0.0193 CU, 1 GB 52.8 s / 0.0147 CU; peak RSS 150-210 MB. 2 GB halves compute at the same speed; 1 GB is 62% slower. August compute cost was $65.79 on $194 developer revenue, so this is worth about $30/month at that volume.

pricing.$comment: Live pricing, recorded for reference. The CI script only sets prices first-time or reconciles decreases; increases are done by hand (14-day notice). Event names must match Actor.charge() calls in main.py.

email-check-completed.eventDescription: Charged once per email checked, covering the scan of 120+ platforms.

account-found.eventDescription: Charged for each platform where the email has a registered account. You only pay for actual hits.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: New value-aligned pricing: $0.02 per email checked + $0.01 per account found. Avg ~$0.05/check. Replaces flat $0.01/result which undercharged for the 120-platform scan.
